svg.title: Whisper tiny — the same model, both views, one vertical axis
svg.desc: torchview 0.2.7's graph of Whisper tiny, 74 boxes on two parallel spines, with the 11 stages of draughtsman's committed spec drawn as tinted regions around the nodes each one collapses, named down the right-hand side.
svg.text: Whisper tiny — 74 traced boxes, 11 stages, one vertical axis
torchview 0.2.7's own layout, scaled to fit. Each tint is one stage of the committed spec,
drawn around the nodes it covers and named on the right.
queries 12 text, keys and values 1500 audio
The encoder and the decoder run at the same levels, so their regions share heights without sharing
place. torchview's layout is 574 × 5203 points, drawn here at 0.30×.
